Parcel price list of Tallow & Finch Couriers
- VAT: 25 % is added to the net amount (after any discount and minimum charge).
- Packaging material is sold separately at the counter.
- We bill the greater of two figures: the weight on the scale, or the dimensional weight, which is the box volume in cubic centimetres divided by 6000 (result in kg). The chargeable weight is rounded up to the next full kilogram before the band is looked up.
- Base prices (a weight exactly on a band limit belongs to the lower band):
   Chargeable weight | Zone A | Zone B | Zone C | Zone D
   up to and including 1 kg | CAD 7.12 | CAD 10.10 | CAD 12.04 | CAD 14.28
   over 1 kg, up to and including 15 kg | CAD 10.15 | CAD 14.40 | CAD 17.17 | CAD 20.36
   over 15 kg, up to and including 25 kg | CAD 14.05 | CAD 19.94 | CAD 23.78 | CAD 28.20
   over 25 kg, up to and including 50 kg | CAD 22.08 | CAD 31.34 | CAD 37.37 | CAD 44.32
- Zone assignment: Zone A: Hungary, Australia and Armenia; Zone B: Malta, Malaysia and Mexico; Zone C: Japan and Ghana; Zone D: Luxembourg, Croatia and Estonia.
- Delivery to a private address: CAD 9.50; business addresses pay nothing extra.
- Parcels heavier than 50 kg are not accepted.
- Oversize charge: CAD 34.50 if the longest side is 80 cm or more.
- Labels can be printed at any of our 827 service points.
- Calculate in this order: (1) work out the chargeable weight (2) look up the base price (3) add the surcharges (4) add VAT (5) round.
- Rounding: keep all intermediate amounts unrounded and round only the final price to the nearest CAD 0.01, halves up.
